decisions.reason: The firm invested heavily and publicly claimed a new industry standard, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
It supports the announced surveillance and automation direction and has public visibility, so management will persist despite any slow results.
The training program had a dedicated page and complements the integrated offering, so some commitment exists, though less central.
It had little investment and only a website mention, so with no strong public commitment and enough time passed, management is more likely to drop it.
The collaboration software tool is central to the announced collaborative decision-making direction and had public visibility, so commitment leads to persistence.
As the flagship and focus of the firm's direction with a public launch, high sunk costs and commitment make dropping highly unlikely.
